name: home
description: Find homes for sale and to rent across the UK in ChatGPT with home.co.uk: full property details, every photo, time on market and price reductions, side-by-side comparisons, area checks, stamp duty and mortgage estimates, and workflows for viewings, shortlists and buying costs.

interface.shortDescription: UK homes for sale and to rent
interface.longDescription:
Home finds homes for sale and to rent across the United Kingdom from home.co.uk, right in the conversation. Describe what you want in your own words: a town, city or postcode, buying or renting, your budget, how many bedrooms, a house or a flat, new build or not, newest or lowest price first. Home shows the matching houses and flats with asking price or rent, photos, bedrooms, tenure, the date each one was added, how long it has been on the market, and whether it has been reduced or gone under offer.

Open any result for the full picture in chat: every photo, the complete description, the agent, key facts and, where the published address can be matched to a property, checks from Homedata such as the EPC energy rating, council tax band, flood and other environmental risks, broadband, nearby schools and recorded crime. Compare two to four homes side by side, ask what an area is like for schools, broadband, recorded crime, deprivation and local house price growth, and estimate stamp duty or monthly mortgage repayments from your own figures.

Home also brings three workflows: prepare for a viewing, with a checklist and questions for the agent built from the home's own details; shortlist and compare, ranking homes against what matters to you; and buying costs, setting out stamp duty, deposit, loan and monthly repayments together.

It is for anyone house hunting: first-time buyers, movers, renters and families comparing places to live. No account is needed.

Limitations: Home is read-only. It does not value homes or forecast prices, list a home, contact agents for you, or decide mortgage eligibility. Calculator results are estimates, not tax or financial advice, and stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland. Availability and status are snapshots from the time of the search.
